title:
The goal of this epic is to handle a click on the {@link Sensor#operationalStatus} list item.

This epic should be triggered on `LIST_ITEM_CLICK` action. The payload will be an object with information about the
list item that was clicked. Example payload is as follows:

```
// Below must be provided by the user.
modalToOpen: string, // Id of the modal you want to open.
errorBanner: string, // Id of the error banner to show if the requisite permissions are not available.
labelToFilterOn: string, // Value of `label` field in `obj` to filter on.
pathToSensorId: string, // Path to the sensor id within the data spec from `componentDataSpecIdWithSensorData`
componentDataSpecIdWithSensorData: string, // Data spec id of the component that has the sensor data.
// Below comes from LIST_ITEM_CLICK action.
obj: {
  value: string,
  label: string, // Translation label for the item clicked.
  subInfo: string
  ...
}
```

This epic will perform the following:
1. Filter out `LIST_ITEM_CLICK` on definition list items that do not match the label provided in the payload.
2. Retrieve the {@link Sensor#id} from the component data spec (`componentDataSpecIdWithSensorData`) using
   `pathToSensorId`.
3. Return an action `CUSTOM_OPERATING_STATUS_LIST_ITEM_CLICK` with payload property `sensorId` populated.
4. Trigger the {@link OpenSensorSettingsModalEpic} with this same action to open the modal.
name: SensorAlertDetailOpenModalOnListItemClickEpic
